scope: Baldwin’s Tower, the surviving 1933 stone restoration at Tsarevets Fortress in Veliko Tarnovo, with its stair and immediately attached stretches of the cliff-edge curtain.

originalReview.notes: The direct photographic original shows the tower as a distinct cliff-top form with an external stone stair, irregular stone wall and characteristic projected crenellated crown.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed Qualla’s three exact images first. The two independently dedicated Bolyar-house originals show a different structure. The local close-up is a later upload attached to a migrated grant under a different account name, without independently verified continuity. Used the photographer’s exact directly dedicated Commons original of the standing tower.
